instructions: Install the layout, card, feedback, and pagination Blocs used by the public album compositions.
Apply the private Photo Albums schema, create its private originals bucket, and deploy the cms-photo-albums Edge Function.
Install the generated bearer token in the CMS secret store and in the Edge Function secrets.
Create a category and album, upload ordered photos, then publish the album from the backoffice.
scopes: Public responsive photo delivery through CMS Sources
Album, category, photo-media, and settings backoffice workflows
checks: The photo_albums schema and originals bucket stay private to browser clients.
Only published albums and attached photos are exposed through public endpoints.
Upload, replacement, removal, and reorder operations are authorized before changing media state.
Original image metadata and dimensions remain immutable after an upload is accepted.
resources: Basic Blocs layout, card, feedback, and pagination controls
Public catalogue and photo endpoints plus administrator management endpoints
Public album listing and album gallery
Albums with media management, categories, and gallery settings
Private photo_albums schema, private originals bucket, and cms-photo-albums Edge Function
review: Keep source originals in the integration-owned private bucket; do not copy them into cms-files.
Treat removal and replacement as logical detachment of an accepted original.
Do not expose Storage paths, original filenames, or service credentials in public read models.
Keep responsive derivative generation in the CMS Source image pipeline.
sync: Install Photo Albums source, dashboards, and Blocs
syncNote: Supabase owns immutable originals and album state; the CMS owns bounded, disposable responsive derivatives.
